summary.text: Michael Hettig is the Democratic candidate for Georgia State Senate District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Kay Kirkpatrick.
An attorney from Woodstock, he advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Michael Hettig works as a lawyer, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an attorney, advocate and citizen of Woodstock, Georgia, who is running because he believes the district needs leadership focused on solving problems of the people who live there.

He said he supports fully funding public schools and paying teachers competitively, expanding Medicaid and public health programs, and investing in workforce development, infrastructure and local entrepreneurs.
